snippet.title: Sprint City | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Sprint City, a shared-world, competitive 2D platformer by the creators of SpeedRunners!
Early Access launches in 2026 on Steam, wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191250/Sprint_City/

Wall-run, grapple, and sprint through a city built for momentum instead of wheels. Race up to 8 players online, discover shortcuts, customize your Runagade, and invite friends instantly via browser play.

Early Access launches in 2026 on Steam, wishlist now!

Follow Sprint City on:
Official website: sprintcity.io
Discord: https://discord.gg/sprintcity
Twitter/X: https://x.com/playsprintcity
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/sprintcity/?type=TEXT
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playsprintcity/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/playsprintcity.bsky.social
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playsprintcity

Get running!
